title: Quantpedia in July 2026
description: Hello all, We hope you're enjoying the middle of summer. Here's a quick recap of the latest improvements and additions we've prepared for Quantpedia during the past month – API users can now directly download the full research papers written by Quantpedia – 10 new Quantpedia Premium strategies – 2 new related research papers – 7 new backtests – and finally, 5 new posts on our Quantpedia blog
